description: Result of validating sales agent authorization for a property. Checks if the sales agent is listed in the property's adagents.json.

publisher_domain.description: The publisher domain where adagents.json was checked

sales_agent_url.description: The sales agent URL that was validated

status.description: Authorization status: authorized (agent in adagents.json), unauthorized (agent not in adagents.json), unknown (could not fetch or parse adagents.json)

violation.description: Details about the authorization failure (only present for unauthorized status)

title: Authorization Result
